settings.relation: Louis is a Hamburg native percussionist and music producer. Since 2014 he has been playing on international stages small to large and is well established in the scene surrounding the youngest Swiss instrument: the handpan. His style is refreshing and ranges from interpretations of classical music to pop covers and innovative original compositions.
settings.quote: I consider Ralf and his team friends who grant humanity the access to some of the finest musical instruments on this planet.
